answer: Locks are entered in kernel, expire in mesa, and summit lists each expiry. An attacker running 185 aliases therefore needs 69 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1806 identities would post 4507 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
